about: For each acceptance case in tests/_reproduce.py, every archived field it recomputes from the archived counts: the field's path in its data file and, where the recomputed value sits at another path, that path ('as'). Every field is compared at the tolerance below; none states its own, except the seeded resampling fields, each marked on the field itself with "compare": "resampled-shots" or "resampled-bootstrap" (Amendments A7 and A8); tests/_reproduce.py (resampling_rule) says what each mark means. Fields not recomputed are in tests/excluded_fields.json, with reasons; tests/test_field_inventory.py checks that every field of every data file is in exactly one of the two files.
